name: Alpha Multi-State Ecosystem
description: Two species in a shared environment with seasonal audio climate. Bass = harsh season (higher death, lingering toxins), mids = bloom season (explosive resource growth), treble = volatile spore season. Mouse acts as a keystone species that can trigger extinctions or create protected fertile zones. Depth creates stable ecological layers.

params.name: Species 1 Vitality
params.description: Base growth potential for species 1 (amplified in bloom seasons)

params.name: Seasonal Volatility
params.description: How dramatically audio seasons affect the ecosystem (treble spikes create chaos)

params.name: Keystone Impact
params.description: How strongly the mouse (keystone species) can trigger extinction or bloom events
